sloka: हन्तारं दानवेन्द्राणां यक्षाणां च सहस्रशः ।निवातकवचानां च सङ्ग्रहीतारमीश्वरम् ।। ६.११४.५२ ।।
transliteration: hantāraṁ dānavendrāṇāṁ yakṣāṇāṁ ca sahasraśaḥ ।nivātakavacānāṁ ca saṅgrahītāramīśvaram ।। 6.114.52 ।।

translations.english: "He, who commanded uttering harsh words in the presence of the enemy, who protected his own brand, who killed those indulged in terrible deeds.
